summary: Phase 2 Borrower Strength Score (POST /api/ai/borrower-score) tested end-to-end. Backend 13/13 pytest assertions pass (auth, 404, score range, classification thresholds, breakdown structure, points<=max, deterministic score, Claude summary non-empty). Frontend CaseDetail page renders all required testids: borrower-score-card, borrower-score-value (85), borrower-score-classification (Strong), borrower-score-progress (width=85%), borrower-score-summary (Claude-generated 562-char text), and 5 breakdown rows (employment/income/credit/gdpr/documents). Recalculate button toggles to 'Calculating...' and back. Notes regression (add note) works.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/ai.py: bare `except Exception as e` swallows the error and silently degrades — log the exception (e.g., logger.exception) so prod issues with Claude/Emergent LLM key are observable.
routes/ai.py: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY read at module import time. If env loads later or rotates, server restart required. Consider reading inside the handler or fail-fast at startup if missing.

routes/ai.py: no rate limiting / caching on the AI endpoint. Each Recalculate click costs an LLM round-trip (~3-8s and tokens). Consider caching the computed score+summary (e.g., per client_id) with manual invalidation on Recalculate.
routes/ai.py: response shape is `{success, data}` while most other BrokerOS endpoints return data directly. Inconsistent envelope.
CaseDetail.js (~510 lines): approaching the 700-line guideline ceiling — extract BorrowerScoreCard and NotesTimeline into their own components for maintainability.

CaseDetail.js: `recalculate-score-btn` skeleton path (`scoreLoading && !score`) is only used on first load. On subsequent recalculates, the old score keeps rendering and only the button label changes — consider an overlay/spinner so the user sees progress for the 3-8s Claude call.
Frontend: no error-state UI distinct from initial empty-state — a failed recalculate just toasts and leaves stale score on screen with no retry CTA.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing case 09ecdc6c-828e-4134-b316-9c112ccd2848 (James Wilson, scored 85/Strong).
